result:
The bound stated in the proposed solution is most likely wrong. For smooth projective surfaces that are not of maximal Albanese dimension, the classical inequality (Debarre, building on Castelnuovo–de Franchis) is $p_g \ge 2q - 4$, and it is sharp. The logarithmic analogue for $\overline P_1$ and $\overline q$ is $\overline P_1(V) \ge 2\overline q(V) - 4$. The proposed $2q-3$ is therefore not the sharp bound, and the claimed "Castelnuovo–Beauville-type $p_g \ge 2q-3$" does not match the known inequality. My recollection of the log version is not fully verified, so my confidence is moderate.

VERDICT: REJECT
CONFIDENCE: 3
